title: Docs: add a Quick start section to the day-one guide
body:
### Outcome

New contributors can see the first three commands to run at the top of the day-one guide, without reading the whole page.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `docs/agents/day-one.md` has a new `## Quick start` heading. It sits directly before the `## 1. Install assistant files` heading.
- [ ] The new section lists these three commands, in this order, each as a bullet with the command in backticks and one short phrase: `pnpm install`, `pnpm quick-setup`, `pnpm dev`.
- [ ] The new section has no more than eight lines.
- [ ] No existing line of `docs/agents/day-one.md` changes. The change only adds lines.
- [ ] No other file changes.

### Scope

`docs/agents/day-one.md` only.

### Validation

docs (a Markdown change; `pnpm format:check` covers it)

### Evidence

`docs/agents/day-one.md` starts with the title and goes straight to `## 1. Install assistant files`. The three commands are in `AGENTS.md`, section "Common Commands".

### Out of scope

Any change to the other steps of the guide, to `AGENTS.md`, or to code.
author: desk-fixture-author
